description: Synthetic wish-list history for one bound member, generated by replaying a fixed seeded sequence of the App's own tools and events. A reusable acceptance fixture, not a benchmark task.

sources.description: People, groups, item names, variants, prices and shop names are invented and hand-written in scripts/build-fixtures.cjs; dates, pairings and statuses come from a seeded generator that replays the App's handlers. No external collection.

transformations: IDs created by the replay are renamed to history IDs and the run counters reset to zero.
The item-added notification setting is off in the replay before 2026-11-01 and on afterwards.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism and of whether every person, shop and item name is invented.
